{"language":"python","code":"from pathlib import Path
import re
p = Path('neuron_growth_openai-gpt-6.1-sol_01.html')
s = p.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
libpath = Path('dat.gui.inline.tmp')
lib = libpath.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
# Replace the reserved library script without changing application code.
pattern = r'<script\b[^>]*>\s*(?:(?:/\*[\s\S]*?\*/)|(?://[^\n]*\n)|\s)*</script>'
m = re.search(pattern, s)
if m is None:
    candidates = re.findall(r'[^\n]*(?:DAT_GUI|dat\.gui|PLACEHOLDER)[^\n]*', s)
    raise RuntimeError('Library insertion slot not found: ' + repr(candidates))
replacement = '<script>\n' + lib.replace('</script', '<\\/script') + '\n</script>'
s = s[:m.start()] + replacement + s[m.end():]
p.write_text(s, encoding='utf-8')
libpath.unlink()
print('Embedded dat.gui in ' + p.name + '; removed temporary library download.')"}
